title: kcapi: add sha3-384 and sha3-512 algorithms
description:
Add sha3-384 and sha3-512 to the kcapi hash provider.

**What:** Extend kcapi_hash.c and its provider registration so sha3-384 and sha3-512 are available through the kernel crypto API path.

**Algorithm:**
1. In kcapi_hash.c: add sha3_384_sess_init wrapper calling kcapi_hash_sess_init_impl(ctx, op, key, keylen, "sha3-384", false)
2. Add sha3_512_sess_init wrapper calling kcapi_hash_sess_init_impl(ctx, op, key, keylen, "sha3-512", false)
3. Add kcapi_sha3_384_ops struct: .algo="sha3-384", .fips_gate=NULL, .sess_init=sha3_384_sess_init; all other fields same as kcapi_sha3_256_ops
4. Add kcapi_sha3_512_ops struct: .algo="sha3-512", .fips_gate=NULL, .sess_init=sha3_512_sess_init; all other fields same as kcapi_sha3_256_ops
5. In kcapi_provider.h: add extern declarations for kcapi_sha3_384_ops and kcapi_sha3_512_ops; update comment to list sha3-384 and sha3-512
6. In kcapi_provider.c: add &kcapi_sha3_384_ops and &kcapi_sha3_512_ops to kcapi_algo_list; increment num_algos from 15 to 17

**Defensive programming rules:**
- kcapi_hash_sess_init_impl handles all error paths internally; no additional error handling needed in wrapper
- Kernel sha3-384 and sha3-512 are available via crypto_alloc_shash("sha3-384", 0, 0) — these are provided by the kernel sha3 module
- No enums, no flags
- fips_gate=NULL is correct for kcapi (non-FIPS provider)

**Agent team:** single implementer
acceptance_criteria: make produces zero errors and zero new warnings. kcapi_sha3_384_ops and kcapi_sha3_512_ops exported. kcapi_provider num_algos = 17.
